reviews.text: Super!! Very good, Billie always looks beautiful.

My 4 year old, mid-sized dog had a great grooming, nails clipping and dental basic cleaning day. The owner truly cares about the result and the dog's experience. The best place in Amsterdam, fully recommended! I still can't believe how happy my dog was after the visit! See you next time!

Absolutely wonderful experience! 🐾 Piccolina - a Pomeranian princess looks absolutely gorgeous after her visit. The team did a fantastic job; you can really see the care, skill and attention to detail that went into her grooming. The ladies are also super sweet and kind. She looks beautiful, smells lovely and is clearly in very good hands.

It’s such a pleasure to find a fur salon that treats your little one with genuine care and takes pride in doing an excellent job. We couldn’t be happier with the result and will definitely be coming back!

Highly recommended for anyone who wants their four-legged family member to look and feel their very best. ❤️🐶

Due to circumstances, Bo had to go to a different/new grooming salon, and that is not easy because he absolutely hates everything involved in grooming, but I got a very cheerful, enthusiastic friend back who looked beautiful too! Definitely intend to return, if there is availability!
Anna did an incredible job with my senior dog Quentin. Best grooming he has ever received!
Very kind and considerate groomer. My standard poodle looks handsome after the grooming and has been a head turner. Also very responsive on WhatsApp and overall a very positive experience.
Super nice lady, I am very satisfied, highly recommended.

Anna is the best groomer we’ve found in Amsterdam after trying a few over the past couple of years. She always does a fabulous job with our teckel, George, and he comes home looking like such a handsome boy! Highly recommend her.
Our pup came back super pretty and soft! Anna is great with dogs and we will definitely go again :)

It was the first time I had my Wire Podenco plucked. I actually love his punky haircut, but when I came to pick him up, he looked absolutely fantastic! I didn't want it too neat, and the owner understood that perfectly. She also takes her time with the dog, and I noticed that immediately with my dog, because he was happily parading around right in the middle of the shop. He almost wanted to come along with me.
